# mimecast_profile_group_members (Data Source)

Read all members of one profile group with cursor pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_profile_group_members" "selected" {
  group_id = "00000000000000000000000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Profile group ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Member domain.
- `email_address` (String, Sensitive) Member email address.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the member is internal.
- `name` (String) Member display name.
- `note` (String) Member note.
- `type` (String) Member type.
